ale_last_exam.name: ale_last_exam
ale_last_exam.purpose: Agents' Last Exam long-horizon professional workflow in a real sandbox with hidden-reference, artifact-first GUI+CLI delivery
ale_last_exam.purpose_zh: Agents' Last Exam 长程专业工作流：在真实沙箱中按隐藏参考答案、以产物优先的方式完成 GUI+CLI 交付

analog_mixed_signal.name: analog_mixed_signal
analog_mixed_signal.purpose: analog/mixed-signal circuits: bias, small-signal gain, feedback, op-amps, filters, noise, device models and data-converter interfaces; executable ngspice operating-point, DC sweep, AC and transient analysis with parameter corners, margins and numerical refinement, not RTL verification, RF/EM, PCB layout or foundry sign-off
analog_mixed_signal.purpose_zh: 模拟与混合信号电路：偏置、反馈、滤波、模型和接口；ngspice 直流、交流、瞬态、多工况裕量诊断与数值收敛

chip_design.name: chip_design
chip_design.purpose: digital ASIC/hardware accelerator subsystems: workload, microarchitecture, compute, memory/DMA, interconnect and host integration; scoped architecture/RTL/PPA tasks or explicit full implementation and sign-off, not GPU software kernels
chip_design.purpose_zh: 模块化数字 ASIC/硬件加速器设计：计算、存储、互联、主机与 PPA，可选局部任务或完整交付流程

classical_poetry.name: classical_poetry
classical_poetry.purpose: compose or check classical Chinese 近体诗/古体/词 with reproducible 押韵/平仄 prosody and literary review
classical_poetry.purpose_zh: 创作或校验中文近体诗/古体/词，押韵、平仄以可复现的方式机器检查，并做文学评审

digital_circuit.name: digital_circuit
digital_circuit.purpose: digital logic and cycle-accurate Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL: combinational/sequential circuits, arithmetic, FSMs, FIFOs, interfaces, CDC, verification and synthesis; not CUDA/Triton kernels or whole-chip architecture
digital_circuit.purpose_zh: 体系化数字电路知识与 RTL：组合/时序、算术、FSM、FIFO、协议、CDC、验证和综合，支持按任务范围选择流程

digital_circuit_benchmark.name: digital_circuit_benchmark
digital_circuit_benchmark.purpose: single-stage fixed-harness RTL benchmark: interface, RTL, local verification, pre-score elaboration, and attempt handoff
digital_circuit_benchmark.purpose_zh: 单阶段固定评测框架的 RTL 基准：接口、RTL、本地验证、评分前展开与尝试交接

digital_circuit_verification.name: digital_circuit_verification
digital_circuit_verification.purpose: independent RTL verification specialty: requirement-to-test matrices, parameter/seed regressions, protocol scoreboards and nonvacuous formal checks; not RTL implementation, analog simulation, timing closure or fixed-harness benchmark submission
digital_circuit_verification.purpose_zh: 独立数字验证专项：需求覆盖矩阵、参数和种子回归、协议计分板、形式证明及非空洞性检查

fiction_writing.name: fiction_writing
fiction_writing.purpose: write or continue original fiction narrative prose while preserving characters, world, and timeline; not a literature review or research task
fiction_writing.purpose_zh: 撰写或续写原创小说叙事文本，保持人物、世界观与时间线一致；不是文献综述或研究任务

fpga_design.name: fpga_design
fpga_design.purpose: FPGA board projects, resource inference, pin/clock constraints and bring-up; executable single-clock iCE40 implementation and hardware measurements, scoped RTL verification or full board delivery; not ASIC physical design or GPU kernels
fpga_design.purpose_zh: FPGA 工程、资源推断、引脚和时钟约束及板级调试；首个可执行实现流程限定单时钟 iCE40，上板需真实测量

kernelbench.name: kernelbench
kernelbench.purpose: maximize correctness-checked SOL score/speedup for GPU kernels on B200 SOL-ExecBench/KernelBench
kernelbench.purpose_zh: 在 B200 SOL-ExecBench/KernelBench 上最大化通过正确性检查的 GPU 内核 SOL 得分/加速比

literary_editor.name: literary_editor
literary_editor.purpose: rewrite, expand, polish, proofread, or critique an existing literary text while preserving edit scope and source facts
literary_editor.purpose_zh: 改写、扩写、润色、校对或评论既有文学文本，保持编辑范围与原文事实不变

materials.name: materials
materials.purpose: materials science and materials processing across atomistic, microstructure, continuum, CAD/CAE, and experimental scales
materials.purpose_zh: 材料科学与材料加工，跨原子、微观组织、连续介质、CAD/CAE 与实验尺度

medical.name: medical
medical.purpose: biomedical and pharmaceutical evidence execution: target-disease mechanisms, human genetics, preclinical translation, clinical trials, safety, failed programs, competitive pipelines, and auditable non-diagnostic decision dossiers with independent review; not a generic paper pipeline
medical.purpose_zh: 生物医药证据执行：靶点-疾病机制、人类遗传学、临床前转化、临床试验、安全性、失败项目、竞争管线，产出可审计的非诊断决策档案并独立评审；不是通用论文流水线

modern_poetry.name: modern_poetry
modern_poetry.purpose: compose or revise modern free verse/prose poems without classical prosody checks; enforce only declared hard constraints
modern_poetry.purpose_zh: 创作或修改现代自由诗/散文诗，不做古典格律检查；只执行声明的硬性约束

nanochat.name: nanochat
nanochat.purpose: minimize val_bpb on the nanochat train.py (bits-per-byte, ~300s, 1 GPU)
nanochat.purpose_zh: 在 nanochat 的 train.py 上最小化 val_bpb（bits-per-byte，约 300 秒，1 张 GPU）

nanogpt_speedrun.name: nanogpt_speedrun
nanogpt_speedrun.purpose: minimize wall-clock time to reach val_loss<=3.28 on modded-nanogpt (8xH100)
nanogpt_speedrun.purpose_zh: 在 modded-nanogpt（8xH100）上最小化达到 val_loss<=3.28 的墙钟时间

package_design.name: package_design
package_design.purpose: Semiconductor package engineering: die attach, wire bond, flip chip and bumps, package substrates, interposers, chiplets, thermal paths, mechanical and assembly constraints; executable Gmsh/CalculiX steady heat conduction through ideal bonded package stacks; not PCB fabrication, RTL, RF network calculation, general structural FEA or physical qualification
package_design.purpose_zh: 半导体封装、键合倒装、基板中介层与芯粒集成知识；可选 Gmsh／CalculiX 理想粘结叠层稳态热传导

pcb_design.name: pcb_design
pcb_design.purpose: PCB and printed circuit board engineering: schematics, components and footprints, stackup, placement, routing, return paths and fabrication preparation; executable KiCad ERC/DRC, schematic-board parity, Gerber and Excellon drill outputs; not RTL, IC layout, RF network calculation, package design, field-solved SI/PI or physical qualification
pcb_design.purpose_zh: PCB 原理图、器件封装、叠层布局布线与制造准备；可选 KiCad 原生 ERC/DRC、图板一致性和 Gerber/钻孔输出

physics.name: physics
physics.purpose: theory, simulation, data analysis, literature, or experiment design for a real physical system with bounded evidence
physics.purpose_zh: 针对真实物理系统、在有界证据下进行理论、模拟、数据分析、文献或实验设计

power_electronics.name: power_electronics
power_electronics.purpose: Power electronics: DC-DC converters, power switches and rectifiers, magnetics, control and protection, losses, filters and layout constraints; native ngspice Buck/Boost startup, ripple, load-step and finite operating/tolerance studies with margins; not general analog signal processing, PCB fabrication, RF networks or physical energizing
power_electronics.purpose_zh: 电力电子：变换器、功率器件、磁性元件与控制保护知识；ngspice Buck/Boost 启动、纹波、负载阶跃、功率平衡与多工况裕量诊断

prose.name: prose
prose.purpose: compose or revise literary essays, memoir, or 抒情/叙事散文/随笔; not verse or plot-driven fiction
prose.purpose_zh: 创作或修改文学随笔、回忆录或抒情/叙事散文/随笔；不是诗歌，也不是情节驱动的小说

quant.name: quant
quant.purpose: equity factor research (IC/ICIR, backtest, Sharpe) producing a reviewer-certified report, not a generic metric loop
quant.purpose_zh: 股票因子研究（IC/ICIR、回测、Sharpe），产出评审员认证的报告，不是通用指标循环

rf_design.name: rf_design
rf_design.purpose: RF and microwave network design: Touchstone/S parameters, impedance matching, transmission lines, port order and reference impedances, passive cascades, noise and stability reasoning; executable scikit-rf network analysis, not RTL, general SPICE transients, full-wave EM, PCB layout or physical certification
rf_design.purpose_zh: 射频与微波网络：S 参数、传输线、阻抗匹配和端口约定；可选 scikit-rf 数据、重归一化与级联分析

speedrun.name: speedrun
speedrun.purpose: single-metric script/benchmark optimization under a wall-clock budget: setup, optimize, measure, report; no paper
speedrun.purpose_zh: 墙钟预算内的单指标脚本/基准优化：搭建、优化、测量、报告；不写论文
